h: What are you waiting to know before you let yourself rest?

label: Today You Will Learn
h: How Christ's peace is given before the answer arrives, and how to tell necessary watching from watching that only exhausts you.
body:
About 8 minutes, plus one short pause · one small practice · no homework list

If you are waiting on a serious result and it has disrupted your sleep, eating or ability to function for more than a couple of weeks, please tell your doctor or the clinical team.

label: Key Scripture
h: "Peace I leave with you; my peace I give to you. Not as the world gives do I give to you. Let not your hearts be troubled, neither let them be afraid."

label: Meet Caleb
h: "I can't rest until we know. It would be like leaving my post."

label: The Horizon That Keeps Moving
body:
The answer keeps movingEach answer reveals the next thing to be known.
Some answers never comeHow a story ends when you will not be there for the ending.
The condition trains the mind to watchA mind told “we rest when we know” gets very good at watching.
Deferred rest becomes a deferred lifeThe life you are guarding is the life you are not living.

label: What Christ's Peace Is Not
body:
Not the absence of concernConcern for what you love can coexist with it.
Not a guaranteed feelingGiven whether or not it is felt.
Not certainty about outcomesIt tells you that you are not beyond his care, not what the scan will show.
Not resignationIt is what lets hope wait without tearing itself apart.

label: Two Kinds of Watching
body:
Necessary watching

The appointments, the questions, the clinical team's guidance.

Anxious watching

Mental surveillance beyond that. It changes no outcome, and removes you from the life you have.

label: A Common Belief
h: "If I stop watching, it means I do not care."
body: Scripture does not connect love with sleeplessness. The psalmist places sleep among God's gifts to those he loves.

label: The Practice
body:
Find the sentenceI will permit myself peace when I know that ______.
The horizon testIf that answer came, what would be the next thing you needed to know?
Unresolved and settledTwo short lists: what I do not know, honestly — and what is already settled.

label: Do This Now
h: Write your sentence. Run the horizon test. Then name one suspended thing to resume this week.
body:
Not as a reward for a good result. Because it is yours to live now.

Pause the audio

label: Remember
h: His peace was given before the answers. You do not need permission you already have.

label: Prayer
body:
Lord Jesus, on the night before the cross,
with nothing resolved, you gave your peace.

I bring you what is unresolved,
and I do not pretend it is settled.

I receive, before I know, the peace you already gave.

Amen.
